questions.stem: 很難想像，數百萬人每天使用的水，是由高山上正在融化的冰川（glaciers）提供的。
questions.answer: It is hard to imagine that the water millions of people use every day is provided by melting glaciers high in the mountains.
accepted_answers: It is difficult to imagine that the water used by millions of people every day is supplied by melting glaciers in high mountains.
It is hard to imagine that the water which millions of people use daily is provided by glaciers melting high up in the mountains.

patterns: 虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋不定詞

questions.stem: 然而，它們已經受到全球暖化的嚴重影響，使得數百萬人未來可能面臨缺水危機。
questions.answer: However, they have been severely affected by global warming, putting millions of people at risk of water shortages in the future.
accepted_answers: However, they have been seriously affected by global warming, leaving millions of people likely to face a water crisis in the future.
However, these glaciers have been seriously affected by global warming, meaning that millions of people may face water shortages in the future.

patterns: 完成式被動（已經受到…影響）
句尾分詞片語表結果（, putting …）

1.explanation_zh: 「很難想像」沒有主詞，用虛主詞 It is hard to imagine that …（真正的主詞是後面的 to imagine …）。「數百萬人每天使用的水」用省略 that 的關係子句 the water (that) millions of people use every day，或過去分詞片語 the water used by …。「是由…提供的」用被動 is provided／supplied by …；「高山上正在融化的冰川」寫成 melting glaciers high in the mountains（melting 表進行中）。
evidence: 是由高山上正在融化的冰川（glaciers）提供的
1.strategy_zh: 中文沒有主詞的「很難…」→ It is hard to V；「是由…＋V＋的」→ be + p.p. + by …。
hints: 切成四段：很難想像／數百萬人每天使用的水／高山上正在融化的冰川／是由…提供的
標的詞彙：hard（困難的）、imagine（想像）、water（水）、use（使用）、day（每天）、melt（融化）、mountain（山）、provide（提供）
句型框架：It is hard to imagine that + the N (that) + S + V + is provided by …

2.explanation_zh: 「然而」用 However 承接上一句。「它們已經受到…的嚴重影響」：冰川是受影響的一方，用現在完成式被動 have been severely affected by …（「嚴重」用副詞 severely／seriously 放在 been 和過去分詞之間）。「使得…」是前面整件事的結果，用句尾分詞 , putting／leaving + 受詞 + …；「可能面臨…」可寫 at risk of + 名詞，或 likely to face …。「缺水危機」用 water shortages 或 a water crisis。
evidence: 已經受到全球暖化的嚴重影響
使得數百萬人未來可能面臨缺水危機
2.strategy_zh: 「已經受到…影響」→ have been affected by …；「…，使得…」→ , putting/leaving + O + …。
hints: 切成四段：它們已經受到全球暖化的嚴重影響／使得數百萬人／未來可能面臨／缺水危機
標的詞彙：affect（影響）、global（全球的）、severely（嚴重地）、face（面臨）、risk（風險）、future（未來）、water（水）、shortage（短缺）
句型框架：However, S + have been severely affected by …, putting + O + at risk of + N + in the future

references: It is hard to imagine that the water millions of people use every day is provided by melting glaciers high in the mountains.
It is difficult to imagine that the water used by millions of people every day is supplied by melting glaciers in high mountains.
It is hard to imagine that the water which millions of people use daily is provided by glaciers melting high up in the mountains.

patterns.label_zh: 虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋不定詞（很難想像）
patterns.frame: It is + hard/difficult + to imagine that …

patterns.zh_trigger: 是由高山上正在融化的冰川（glaciers）提供的

common_errors.right: It is hard to imagine that
common_errors.explanation_zh: 中文「很難想像」沒有主詞，英文要補上虛主詞 It：It is hard to imagine …。
It is + 形容詞 + to 後面接原形動詞。

parts.zh: 數百萬人每天使用的水
accepted: the water millions of people use every day
the water used by millions of people every day
the water which millions of people use daily
the water that millions of people use every day

common_errors.wrong: the water millions of people use it every day
common_errors.right: the water millions of people use every day
common_errors.explanation_zh: 關係子句的受詞就是前面的 the water，子句裡不可再寫 it。

common_errors.wrong: the millions of people use every day water
common_errors.right: the water millions of people use every day
common_errors.explanation_zh: 中文修飾語「數百萬人每天使用的」在前，英文要先寫 the water，再用（省略 that 的）關係子句修飾。

parts.zh: 高山上正在融化的冰川
accepted: melting glaciers high in the mountains
glaciers melting high up in the mountains
glaciers melting high in the mountains

common_errors.wrong: melted glaciers high in the mountains
common_errors.right: melting glaciers high in the mountains
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「正在融化」表示進行中，用現在分詞 melting；melted 是「已經融化的」。

common_errors.wrong: glaciers which melting high in the mountains
common_errors.right: glaciers melting high in the mountains
common_errors.explanation_zh: which 子句要有完整動詞（which are melting）；不然就直接用分詞片語 glaciers melting …。
被動是 be + 過去分詞 provided。
被動語態的動作者用 by 引出（provided by glaciers）。

traps.literal_error: Hard to imagine that the water …
traps.explanation_zh: 「很難想像」沒有主詞，英文要用虛主詞 It is hard to imagine …，不能直接用 Hard 開頭。

traps.zh: 數百萬人每天使用的水
traps.literal_error: the millions of people every day use water
traps.explanation_zh: 中文修飾語「數百萬人每天使用的」在名詞前，英文要先寫 the water，再用關係子句（可省略 that）或過去分詞片語 used by … 往後修飾。

bonus.text: Hard as it is to imagine, the water millions of people rely on every day comes from glaciers slowly melting high in the mountains.
bonus.explanation_zh: Hard as it is to imagine（雖然難以想像）是 as 引導的讓步倒裝；rely on（仰賴）比 use 更貼切。倒裝只是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 「數百萬人每天使用的水」中文修飾語在前，英文改成 the water (that) millions of people use every day；「是由…提供的」改成被動 is provided by …；「很難想像」補上虛主詞 It。

references: However, they have been severely affected by global warming, putting millions of people at risk of water shortages in the future.
However, they have been seriously affected by global warming, leaving millions of people likely to face a water crisis in the future.
However, these glaciers have been seriously affected by global warming, meaning that millions of people may face water shortages in the future.

patterns.label_zh: 完成式被動（已經受到…影響）
patterns.zh_trigger: 已經受到全球暖化的嚴重影響

patterns.label_zh: 句尾分詞片語表結果（使得…）

parts.zh: 它們已經受到全球暖化的嚴重影響
accepted: they have been severely affected by global warming
they have been seriously affected by global warming
these glaciers have been seriously affected by global warming
these glaciers have been severely affected by global warming

common_errors.wrong: they have affected seriously by global warming
common_errors.right: they have been seriously affected by global warming
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「受到…影響」是被動，現在完成式被動要寫 have been affected；少了 been 就變成主動。

common_errors.wrong: they have been seriously effected by global warming
common_errors.right: they have been seriously affected by global warming
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「影響」的動詞是 affect；effect 多當名詞（an effect on …）。

common_errors.wrong: global warming, makes millions of people
common_errors.right: global warming, putting millions of people
common_errors.explanation_zh: 前面已有完整句子，表結果要用句尾分詞（putting／leaving／causing），不能再接另一個現在式動詞 makes。
用 which 就要接完整動詞（which puts …）；用分詞就不要 which。
情態助動詞 may 後面接原形動詞 face。
「有…的風險」是 at risk of + 名詞／V-ing，介系詞用 of。

accepted: a water crisis in the future

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「缺水危機」不要逐字寫 lack water crisis；用 water shortages 或 a water crisis。
泛指未來可能多次發生的缺水，用複數 shortages（或 a water shortage）。

traps.zh: 已經受到全球暖化的嚴重影響
traps.literal_error: However, they are seriously affected by global warming already
traps.explanation_zh: 「已經受到…」表示到現在已經造成的結果，用現在完成式被動 have been (severely) affected by …。
「缺水危機」是複合概念，不能逐字疊成 lack water crisis；英文說 water shortages 或 a water crisis。

bonus.text: However, global warming has already taken a heavy toll on them, leaving millions of people facing possible water shortages in the years ahead.
bonus.explanation_zh: 改用主動 global warming has taken a heavy toll on them（對它們造成重大損害），再以句尾分詞 leaving … facing … 表結果；in the years ahead 比 in the future 更有文采。這是加分寫法。

2.restructuring_zh: 「使得數百萬人…」承接前面整件事，英文用句尾分詞 putting millions of people at risk of …；「可能面臨缺水危機」可以名詞化成 at risk of water shortages。

1.translation: It is hard to imagine that the water millions of people use every day is provided by glaciers that are melting high in the mountains.
1.explanation_zh: 「很難想像」用虛主詞 It is hard to imagine that；「數百萬人每天使用的水」用省略關係代名詞的子句修飾 water；「是由…提供的」用被動 is provided by；「正在融化的冰川」用關係子句 that are melting（也可 melting glaciers）；「高山上」用 high in the mountains。

2.translation: However, they have already been seriously affected by global warming, which means that millions of people may face a water shortage crisis in the future.
2.explanation_zh: 「已經受到…嚴重影響」用現在完成被動 have already been seriously affected by；「使得…」是結果，用 which means that（也可 which may leave millions of people facing…）；「可能面臨缺水危機」用 may face a water shortage crisis（water crisis 也可）。

issues_zh: 盲譯用 , which means that millions of people may face …（非限定關係子句）表示「使得…」，沒有用到標的句型 PART；「使得」同樣自然引出 which 子句（本批其他題的「這讓／這意味著」都以 NRREL 為標的），中文並沒有唯一引出句尾分詞。建議第 2 部分 accepted 補 which means (that)／which may leave／which puts，或改寫中文、調整標的句型。
第 3 部分 zh 是「未來可能面臨」、targets 有 future，但 accepted（at risk of／likely to face／may face／could face）都沒有 future；in the future 卻放在第 4 部分「缺水危機」的 accepted 裡，「未來」的歸屬切得不一致。
題目有「已經」，但三個參考譯文和第 1 部分 accepted 都沒有 already；盲譯寫 have already been seriously affected 不在清單內，建議補上含 already 的寫法。盲譯的 a water shortage crisis 也不在第 4 部分 accepted 內（可考慮補，或在常見錯誤說明 shortage crisis 略重複）。

1.translation: It is hard to imagine that the water millions of people use every day is supplied by melting glaciers high in the mountains.
1.explanation_zh: 「很難想像」用虛主詞 It is hard to imagine that ...；「數百萬人每天使用的水」用省略關係代名詞的子句 the water millions of people use every day；「由……提供」用被動 is supplied by；「正在融化的冰川」用 melting glaciers，「高山上」用 high in the mountains。

2.translation: However, they have already been seriously affected by global warming, which may cause millions of people to face a water shortage crisis in the future.
2.explanation_zh: 「它們」指冰川，用 they；「已經受到……嚴重影響」用現在完成被動 have already been seriously affected；「使得……可能面臨」用 which may cause ... to face。「缺水危機」譯成 water shortage crisis。信心 medium 是因為「使得」也可以用 so 或 leaving 分詞構句，我不確定出題者預期哪一種接法。

第 2 部分 accepted 全是分詞（putting、leaving、meaning that、causing…to），沒有 which 子句、so、As a result 等同樣正確的寫法。
